notes.title: LOCALIZATION UPDATE
notes.content:
[p][b]We are happy to announce the release of the localization update![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mYl8X3y4dIU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Now you can play Keep Driving in the following languages:
English, German, French, Spanish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified) and Japanese!
It's been a lot of work to get this done, and we want to thank all translators, QA testers and programmer Juju Adams who helped us with a great localization system.

This update also adds some new content to the game (including a new ending). 

Thanks for everyone who's enjoyed and supported the game!
Cheers,
Christopher & Josef

Full patch notes follows:
[/p][p][b]LOCALIZATION:[/b]
- Added new languages to the game:[/p][p]	- German[/p][p]	- Swedish[/p][p]	- Spanish[/p][p]	- Portuguese (Brazilian)[/p][p]	- Chinese (Simplified)[/p][p]	- Japanese[/p][p]	- Ukrainian[/p][p]	- French[/p][p]	- Russian[/p][p](You can change language in the options menu)
[/p][p][b]NEW CONTENT:[/b][/p][p]- Added a new hitchhiker[/p][p]- Added a new ending[/p][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][p]- Fixed bug where the garage-screen could be seen behind the inventory screen when using the muscle car[/p][p]- Fixed bug where the shop in pubs/cafe wouldn't display correctly[/p][p]- Fixed weird audio bug "clicking-sound"[/p][p]- Fixed bug where if you got a black-out when in the music-menu, the music menu would be locked on the screen[/p][p]- Fixed bug where, if exiting the junkyard by walking out, the map would instantly close down when trying to open it.[/p][p]- Fixed bug where the little junkyard-avatar would be walking when you opened the junkyard[/p][p]- Fixed some typos[/p][p]- Fixed bug where if you couldn't afford paying at a hostel and used a gamepad, you would soft-lock yourself[/p][p]- Fixed several instances of formatting errors (i.e. displaying text such as §armor etc)[/p][p]- Fixed issue where the wrong tooltip would sometimes be displayed when hovering the legend-icons in the map[/p][p]- Working at night in the desert won't give you the cold status anymore[/p][p]- "music blasting" event-effect effect is now tied to stereo/subwoofer upgrade.[/p][p]- You will now lose the cold-status when day breaks in the desert[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.0.0e
notes.content:
- Save issues

It has come to our attention that some players have experienced data loss following a crash. I have added an extra failsafe, when loading, to restore missing save-files if for any reason the save-file would disappear. From some research I've done it's probably related to an engine-problem where files that have been written to sometimes get deleted completely if the computer crashes while the game is running.
If any data-loss still appears to anyone after this update, please report it to us so we can look into it more.

To those who have experienced data-loss, I am very sorry. I will put up a guide on how to manipulate a save-file to add certain endings. This can obviously be used to cheat, but I think it's nice to have this for those who lost data.

On another note there have been reports on cloud-saved not working properly. Especially between steamdeck and PC. We've been notified that there have been some faults with the custom cloud-path setup on our end that created files in the home directory. That shouldn't have affected the cloud saves, but now the game won't create unnecessary folders at least.
Be sure to always wait for the cloud saves to finish uploading/downloading when switching between deck/pc.

There are more bugs that we are aware of that will be fixed in the upcoming bigger patch. Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: LudoNarraCon x Keep Driving Sale
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We really want to thank all 100,000+ people that bought the game to this date and we are so proud that its done this well. It's been our riskiest game as it took us 5+ years to make and by far the most difficult to design and execute so this is overwhelmingly huge for us. It paid off! If you enjoyed the game but haven't written a review, please write one. It means so much to us and to steam visibility to have lots of reviews, especially positive reviews that reflect the game. :)

Along with all the sales we've also won the prestigious Indie Cade Grand Jury Award, nominated at Amaze (yet to see if we win), and a lot of great scores and reviews:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/rpg/keep-driving-review/]PC Gamer[/url] - 90/100 "A management RPG that perfectly captures the feel of a long and memorable road trip."
[*] [url=https://www.polygon.com/review/524612/keep-driving-review-pc]Polygon[/url] - recommended "This road-trip sim is a great storytelling system about a joyfully wasted youth"
[*] [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/keep-driving-review]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url] - recommended "A free-wheeling RPG road trip that pushes all the right buttons. Manage spare tires and drink endless coffee while you trundle to the other side of a pixel pleasant country."
[*] [url=https://gamerant.com/keep-driving-review/]Gamerant[/url] - 10/10 "Keep Driving's setting is nothing spectacular, but that's precisely the point."
[*] [url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/28/arts/keep-driving-while-waiting-urban-myth-dissolution-center.html]The New York Times[/url] - recommended "Although Keep Driving has a profoundly hopeful message, it also captures the raucous plasticity and vivacious drive of youth, reminding us that we all once wound up stranded without gas on the side of an empty road."
[/list]

[h3]New Update - Controller support and Steam Deck verification[/h3]

Right now we are looking forward to a pretty stable future for the game with a few content updates, localization and later in the year consoles. This new update includes controller support (which will result in it being steam deck verified soon) - that being the big one - and a few smaller ones: double the amount of decals, and a couple new places to interact with.

In our next content update we'll take a look at upgrades and threats and see if we can give them a bit of a touch up! There's a little teaser 

[previewyoutube=YfELKTLjsvI;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
Christopher & Josef
Y/CJ/Y

notes.title: 2025 Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey!
Keep Driving has been out now for close to 2 months and we're really happy with all the positive feedback and all the wonderful messages some of you've sent us. <3

I know a lot of people are wondering what the plans are, especially about localization and porting, so I thought I'd post a message to get you guys in the loop.

We have planned 4 updates during 2025, not including bug fixes and patches:
[list]
[*] [b]April[/b] - content and controller support
[*] [b]May[/b] - smaller content update
[*] [b]Late summer/early fall[/b] - localization
[*] [b]Late fall/early winter[/b] - consoles
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023475/f84fce282b7276d98ba6643770ca516446c7f3ce.png[/img]

One thing to keep in mind is that [u]nothing is set in stone[/u] with the dates and we still don't know exactly what consoles we are doing. Switch is most likely going to be included. Things like the junkyard or camping ground might be moved to the may update.

As for the [b]languages[/b], the ones we know we'll have are: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Russian and Ukrainian. These are based on sales, consoles, and steam demographics.

Lastly, as some of you know, we are a two person team (with Vile Hartman hired for the sound design) that have coded and drawn everything in the game from scratch. However, this year will be a bit different because of personal circumstances. So we will be working with the great Gamemaker guru Juju Adams for localization and porting. This is also why we won't be releasing many content updates and taking it a bit slower with the updates.

Keep Driving,
xo
Josef & Christopher
Y/CJ/Y


[i]PS. Take it easy everyone. Hopefully this year we will continue to see the game growing, solidifying itself in the tapestry of great indie games, with the message that life goes on, the big the small, the good the bad; life keeps on going. And how important it is to appreciate the fleeting beauty of the world, and the fleeting beauty people you stumble upon, and the fleeting beauty of now. Especially if you're young. It doesn't last forever.[/i]

notes.title: Keep Driving is finally out!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone, it’s Christopher and Josef! Today’s finally the day: Keep Driving is OUT NOW!![/h3]

[previewyoutube=k6eFgU9XiHg;full][/previewyoutube]

It's hard to express how it feels releasing a game we've worked on since 2016. We failed once, put it on ice, came back to it and devoted all our effort to make it happen. It's been helluva project, much bigger than we initially thought it would be, but we're incredibly proud to finally say: [i]IT'S OUT![/i]

Thanks so much to all of you who have come on this ride with us in the months since we announced. When we revealed our game last fall, we would’ve never thought we’d have this much support at launch. We really hope you enjoy this game, we’ve worked so hard on making it. 

[h3]What is Keep Driving?[/h3]
Keep Driving is a [b]management RPG[/b] about slowly making your way through a procedurally generated pixel art open world. Pick up hitchhikers with their own personalities and stories; upgrade, customize and repair your car. Solve challenges on the road using a unique turn-based ‘combat’ system, using your own skills and whatever’s lying around in the glovebox to make it through and explore your summer possibilities.

[h3]Road Map[/h3]
We have some plans for the future of Keep Driving, though we’re not quite ready to go into specifics yet. Just know we have ideas for more features, and we’re also [b]planning more languages and controller support[/b]. Let us know what you think re: things you’d like to see! We’ll keep a close eye on feedback and look forward to adding new content. 

[h3]Follow us on[/h3]
 [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://bsky.app/profile/ycjygames.bsky.social]Blusky[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord [/url]to keep up with our post-launch updates! And be sure to tell your friends if you like our game, it means so much to a two person team like ours. Every bit helps! 🙂 [b]And please leave a review if you enjoy Keep Driving![/b]

Sincerely,
Josef & Christopher

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi again everyone! Christopher and Josef here again. [/h3]

Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone for the feedback and such an amazingly positive reaction to Keep Driving. We have been completely blown away by your comments, especially on Twitter, where things [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames/status/1841466616992670034]absolutely blew up[/url]! Kotaku, Rock Paper Shotgun and PC Games even [url=https://kotaku.com/keep-driving-road-trip-sim-rpg-chill-steam-trailer-pc-1851671194?rev=1728679747622]gave us a shout out[/url] already!

[h3]You can watch the reveal trailer below if you missed it previously.[/h3]

Today, we’re even more excited to let you get hands-on with our first-ever demo for the game. You’ll get a taste of things to come as you spend a weekend driving to your friend's house to play a video game, encountering hitchhikers, taking odd jobs, and keeping your vehicle running on the way. You’ll get a sneak peek into our procedurally generated world with its naturalistic pixel art, a couple of endings including a specially made main story for the demo, and a fantastic but limited (for the demo) soundtrack by local indie bands Westkust and Crystal Boys!

We’d LOVE to hear what you think of the demo, so feel free to comment on the Steam forms here, let us know on [url=www.x.com/ycjygames]Twitter[/url], or join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord[/url], which will become more active in the coming months.

Cheers!
Christopher & Josef
